test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: What happens when the ponds are heavily managed?

options.text: The number of bird species increases.
The water quality of the pond declines.
The number of bird species declines.
Greater diversity of habitat for birds is provided.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The number of bird species declines**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **second paragraph**, it is stated that some water bodies are heavily managed, others are entirely ignored, some are accessible, others are hard to approach. Factors such as water quality, garbage levels and foliage also vary. Importantly, this variety allows multiple birds to use these ponds.
 
• It is mentioned In the **second last line of the second paragraph** that ponds with less management interventions had greater diversity of habitats birds could use — as these interventions grew, the number of bird species declined.
 
• It can be summarised from these statements that there is a direct correlation between the **preservation of water bodies and the conservation of birdlife** in the region.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.
